profile.ja: 陰陽師。陰陽師の名門、柳生家の執事。陰陽師を養成する組織・五行学園で教師も務める。隻眼で、怒ると眼帯を透過するほどの光を発するという。６年もの間自衛陸軍特殊部隊に所属していて、あらゆる戦闘技術をマスターした近接格闘武器戦闘のスペシャリスト。式神として手長＜ウェポンアーム＞を使役し、“四刀流”の異名を持つ剣士でもある。得物は二対の聖剣“天之尾刃張”。
profile.en: She is a master of onmyodo, serving as the steward of the prestigious Yagyu family and a teacher at the Gogyo Academy, which trains onmyodo practitioners. She has one eye and is said to emit intense light from her eye patch when enraged. Having spent six years in the special forces of the self-defense army, she is a specialist in close combat and melee warfare, mastering various fighting techniques. She wields the sacred swords "Ama no Habakiri" and uses the Weapon Arm as her shikigami, earning her the nickname "four-sword style" swordsman.

text.ja: 柳生家の執事にして五行学園教師、志木麗佳だ。五車学園の学生がどれほどの物か、見定めさせてもらう
text.en: I'm Shiki Reika, the steward of the Yagyu family and a teacher at Gogyo Academy. I'll be evaluating the students of Gosha Academy to see what they're capable of.

text.ja: 執事と秘書、それにメイドや御庭番……お前１人に対して随分と人手を割いているようだな。私はお嬢様を１人で十全に支えているというのに
text.en: You're assigning a lot of people to serve you, aren't you? I, on the other hand, can take care of my lady all by myself.

text.ja: 五車学園の教師陣には中々の強者が揃っているようだな。だが、生徒は玉石混淆――まあ、学生とはえてしてそういう物か
text.en: The faculty at Gosha Academy seems to have some strong individuals. However, the students are a mixed bag - I suppose that's to be expected.

text.ja: お嬢様を守る執事となる為に、軍に所属して戦闘術を学び鍛えてきた。もちろん、執事として身の回りの世話も完璧だ
text.en: To become a steward and protect my lady, I joined the military and honed my combat skills. Of course, I'm also perfect at taking care of her daily needs as her steward.

text.ja: あの執事の腕がサイボーグ・アームか。私の手長＜ウェポンアーム＞とは全くの別物だが……侮れないな
text.en: I see that butler has a cybernetic arm. It's completely different from my Weapon Arm, but... I won't underestimate him.

text.ja: 私のお嬢様は実に優秀なんだ。勉学だけで無く戦闘術の飲み込みも早い。まさに仕えるに値する人と言える
text.en: My lady is truly exceptional. She excels not only in her studies but also in picking up combat techniques. She's definitely worth serving.

text.ja: 天之尾刃張を抜く必要のある相手は滅多にいない。大体は仕込み武器による暗器術で仕留めている
text.en: I rarely need to draw my Ama no Habakiri. Most of the time, I can take care of my opponents with my concealed weapons and dark arts.

text.ja: 対魔忍が魔族とも手を組むのか。式として使役する事はあっても協力関係というのは、危いものだと思うが……
text.en: I'm not sure about the Taimanin forming alliances with demons. While I do use them as shikigami, I think cooperation is a risky business...

text.ja: ふふふ……ああ、身体が疼いて堪らない♪　早くチンポを濡れ濡れマンコにねじ込んで犯してぇ……♪
text.en: Hehehe... Ah, my body aches so much. I want you to hurry up and thrust your cock into my wet pussy...

text.en: Haa haa... I'm a lascivious bitch. Just talking about it makes my pussy twitch and my juices flow...
